name: WECO
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the DeFiHackLabs root-cause title.

descriptions.text: The WECO staking contract's deposit(amount, weeksLocked) function mis-handled its internal token accounting. The attacker deposited a large amount, then made many small repeated deposits which credited stake/reward bookkeeping in a way that did not properly reconcile against the tokens actually transferred in, effectively letting the depositor reclaim more WECOIN than they put in. The PoC seeds the attacker with WECOIN, deposits the full balance, then loops calling deposit(1 ether, 0) until the staking contract's WECOIN balance is drained. There is no guard ensuring credited balances stay consistent with the contract's real token holdings.
